items.title: 喜报！AES100发动机获唯一特等奖
items.excerpt: AECC reports six 2026 Chinese Society of Aeronautics and Astronautics science-and-technology awards. The AES100 civil turboshaft won the sole grand prize; other awarded work covers additive manufacturing of high-temperature complex thin-wall engine parts, blade clearance/transient displacement measurement, turbine aero-thermal design/validation, and high-heat-capacity combustor liner cooling.

items.title: CEO: 737-10 certification ‘very soon,’ more to do to stabilize production
items.excerpt: Boeing says 737-10 flight testing is complete and the program is in final FAA documentation; 777-9 testing continues toward first delivery in 2027. Boeing also says 737 production is running at Rate 47 but not yet stable, 787 is stable at Rate 8 and targeting Rate 10, with a second 787 assembly facility under construction for future rate increases.
items.query: site:boeing.com/features/2026/09 Boeing aircraft manufacturing engineering September 2026

items.title: Boeing, American Airlines Complete First 737 MAX Landing Gear Exchange
items.excerpt: Boeing and American Airlines completed the first landing-gear exchange for a 737 MAX, extending Boeing’s exchange program to the MAX platform. Boeing says the program supplies fully overhauled, Boeing-certified main and nose gear assemblies ready for installation, intended to reduce aircraft-on-ground time and improve maintenance predictability.

items.title: Associate Digital Engineering (DE) Process Engineer
items.excerpt: A Boeing Defense, Space & Security posting for its Air Dominance Digital Engineering team states that a proprietary program is maturing a next-generation Digital Engineering and PLM system for engineering and manufacturing. Boeing describes it as a foundation for Model-Based Engineering, additive manufacturing and cross-discipline collaboration.

items.title: Liebherr-Aerospace and China Airlines reach an agreement for Airbus A350 nose landing gear overhaul
items.category: 航空機エンジン・部品
items.excerpt: Liebherr-Aerospace will provide exchange and overhaul support for the nose landing gear on China Airlines’ 18-aircraft A350 fleet, with the campaign starting in 2026 and continuing through 2031. China Airlines is the launch customer in Asia for Liebherr’s A350 nose-landing-gear overhaul program; the gear was developed, manufactured and certified by Liebherr-Aerospace Lindenberg.

items.title: DCS Awarded Prime Position on $85M Air Force IDIQ for Aerospace Systems Research
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: DCS won a prime position on an $85M-ceiling AFRL IDIQ for Digital System-Level Mission-Driven Integrated Design Methods for Aerospace Systems (VOLARE). DCS says the work will enable a vehicle-system design product and thermal-management-system design methodologies, directly aligning with digital engineering and multidisciplinary aerospace design.
items.query: site:dcscorp.com September 2026 VOLARE aerospace systems design DCS

items.title: AML3D joins A$3.9M Advanced Aerospace Manufacturing Project
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: AML3D joined a three-year A$3.89M aerospace R&D project with an unnamed aerospace prime and research partners to qualify its Wire-Arc Additive Manufacturing process for aerospace tooling production. AML3D already holds AS9100D accreditation; the project creates a formal qualification path toward aerospace tooling supply.
